answer: Workflow automation is software that runs a sequence of steps across your apps automatically when something happens, such as a form submission, a new email or a scheduled time. AI workflow automation adds steps where a language model reads, classifies or writes content, so workflows can handle unstructured information too.
body:
What AI workflow automation can do

Most teams have dozens of small, repetitive workflows: a web enquiry becomes a CRM record and a follow-up email, an invoice email becomes a bill, a completed job becomes a review request. Each takes only minutes, but together they consume hours every week and are easy to forget on busy days. Workflow automation runs them the same way every time.

Adding AI widens what can be automated. Instead of only moving structured data, workflows can now:

  • read an email or attachment and pull out the details that matter
  • classify requests by type, urgency or customer and route them correctly
  • draft replies, summaries and notes in your tone of voice
  • check content against your rules and flag anything unusual
  • translate, tidy or reformat information for the next system

Choosing a workflow platform

We are platform-neutral. The right choice depends on your volumes, budget, security needs and who will maintain the workflows.

PlatformBest forConsider
n8nComplex logic, AI steps, high volumes, self-hosting for data controlNeeds hosting and a bit more technical maintenance
MakeVisual workflows your team can read and adjustPricing grows with operations at high volume
ZapierQuick connections across a huge app catalogueLess suited to complex branching or heavy volumes
Power AutomateBusinesses standardised on Microsoft 365Licensing depends on your Microsoft plan

As n8n consultants, we often recommend self-hosted n8n for businesses that want workflows and data processed in an Australian hosting region. For small teams that want to edit workflows themselves, Make or Zapier may be the better fit.

Example workflows we build

Enquiry to booked call

A web form or email enquiry triggers the workflow. AI reads the message, scores the lead, writes a personal reply and offers booking times. The contact, score and conversation are saved in your CRM, and the sales owner gets a summary.

Invoice email to draft bill

A supplier invoice arrives. AI extracts supplier, ABN, amounts, GST and due date, the workflow matches it to the supplier in Xero and creates a draft bill with the PDF attached. Anything unusual goes to your bookkeeper for review.

Completed job to review request

When a job is marked complete, the customer receives a thank-you message and a review link a day later. Negative feedback is routed to a manager before it becomes a public review.

Monday management report

Every Monday morning, figures are pulled from your CRM, accounting software and spreadsheets, AI writes a plain-English summary of what changed, and the report is posted to your team channel.

Built to keep running

Workflows usually break quietly: an app changes a field, a password expires, an unusual email arrives. Every Crenosoft workflow includes:

  • Error handling with retries and alerts to a named person
  • Run logs so you can trace what happened to any record
  • Approval steps for payments, customer-facing messages and low-confidence AI output
  • Test cases from your real past data, including edge cases
  • Documentation of triggers, steps, credentials and owners

We also offer monthly support: monitoring, fixes when connected apps change, and small improvements.

Data and privacy

Workflows only pass AI models the fields each step needs. Credentials are stored securely, access is limited to named staff, and data handling follows the Privacy Act 1988 and the OAIC’s AI product guidance.

How we deliver workflow automation

  1. Free AI audit to list and prioritise your candidate workflows.
  2. Design of triggers, steps, AI prompts and approval points.
  3. Build and test on real examples, usually one to two weeks per workflow.
  4. Handover with documentation and a short training session.
  5. Ongoing support and a monthly report on runs and hours saved.

For larger, cross-team changes, see business process automation. For workflows built around your sales pipeline, see CRM automation.

A good first workflow is one that runs at least daily, follows the same pattern most of the time and currently involves copying information between two systems. Those workflows pay back fastest and give your team confidence before you automate anything more complex.
faqs: Is n8n better than Make or Zapier?

Not always. n8n suits complex logic, AI-heavy steps, high volumes and self-hosting. Make suits teams who want a visual builder they can adjust themselves, and Zapier suits quick connections across many apps. We recommend one after reviewing your needs.
Can workflows run in Australia for data residency?

Yes. Self-hosted n8n can run in an Australian cloud region, so workflow data is processed there. For AI steps we choose providers and settings that suit your data requirements and document where each step runs.
What happens when a workflow fails?

It retries automatically, then alerts a named person with the error and the record affected. With our monthly support, we fix the cause, such as a changed field in a connected app, and confirm the backlog has processed.
Can my team edit the workflows after you build them?
Yes. We document every workflow and can train your team. Make and Zapier are the easiest for non-technical staff to adjust; n8n suits teams with some technical confidence or ongoing support from us.
